title: Adaptive Conformal Prediction for Improving Factuality of Generations by Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.13991v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are prone to generating factually incorrect outputs. Recent work has applied conformal prediction to provide uncertainty estimates and statistical guarantees for the factuality of LLM generations. However, existing approaches are typically not prompt-adaptive, limiting their ability to capture input-dependent variability. As a result, they may filter out too few items (leading to over-coverage) or too many (under-coverage) for a given task or prompt. We propose an adaptive conformal prediction approach that extends conformal score transformation methods to LLMs, with applications to long-form generation and multiple-choice question answering. This enables prompt-dependent calibration, retaining marginal coverage guarantees while improving conditional coverage. In addition, the approach naturally supports selective prediction, allowing unreliable claims or answer choices to be filtered out in downstr

translated_title: 自适应共形预测：提升大语言模型生成内容的事实性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）容易生成事实性错误的输出。近期的工作将共形预测应用于为大语言模型生成内容的事实性提供不确定性估计和统计保证。然而，现有方法通常无法自适应提示词，限制了其捕捉输入相关变化的能力。因此，对于给定的任务或提示，这些方法可能过滤掉过少的条目（导致过度覆盖）或过滤掉过多条目（导致覆盖不足）。我们提出了一种自适应共形预测方法，将共形分数变换方法扩展到大语言模型中，并应用于长文本生成和多选题问答任务。该方法实现了依赖于提示词的校准，在保持边际覆盖保证的同时提高了条件覆盖率。此外，该方法还自然地支持选择性预测，允许在下游应用中过滤掉不可靠的陈述或答案选项。
tldr: 提出了一种提示词自适应的共形预测方法，通过提示词相关的校准提升大语言模型生成内容的事实性，在保持边际覆盖保证的同时改善条件覆盖率，并支持选择性预测以过滤不可靠输出。
en_tdlr: An adaptive conformal prediction approach is proposed that enables prompt-dependent calibration for LLM generations, retaining marginal coverage guarantees while improving conditional coverage and supporting selective prediction to filter out unreliable outputs.
